assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production website background wallpaper for K-LOL.GG, a Korean League of Legends community with an existing elegant pastel blue and lavender fantasy theme. Create an exquisitely painted original fantasy arena garden at dawn: graceful pale stone arches at the far left and far right edges, softly glowing blue crystal formations, distant floating cliffs, a few delicate lavender blossoms and luminous mist. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, 2048x1152 if possible. The central 65 percent and upper center must be a very quiet, extremely pale blue-lilac mist with minimal contrast for dark Korean UI text overlaid later. Rich environmental detail confined mostly to lateral edges and lower corners, softly fading into the center. High quality game key art, luminous depth, tasteful refined fantasy craftsmanship, blue-white/lavender palette with tiny warm gold accents. No characters, no people, no words, no letters, no logos, no interface, no frames, no watermark. This is a background image itself, not a screenshot or mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: dark feature-panel background for K-LOL.GG rankings and fantasy tournament pages. Generate an original ceremonial moonlit arena interior with opulent but refined violet-blue crystal architecture, slim antique gold accents on distant carved columns at far left and right, small luminous stars, soft velvet-like violet mist and a subtle circular illuminated floor near the very bottom. Wide 16:9 landscape 2048x1152 if possible. Keep the central 70 percent and most of the upper center dark midnight indigo, uncluttered, low detail and even exposure, designed for bright UI text and ranking player cards to be overlaid. Contrast and intricate detail should live only along the outermost edges. Premium polished game environment illustration, compatible with a pastel blue/lavender fantasy community website. No characters, no people, no text, no letterforms, no logos, no numbers, no medals or trophy centerpiece, no UI mockup, no watermark.

Use case: texture. Production website panel background for an elegant blue and lavender fantasy game community. Create a seamless-looking very pale pearlescent crystal-glass texture, almost white in the central 85 percent with delicate translucent icy blue and lavender refractions, subtle fine silk grain, extremely faint curved wisps of light near the outer edges, tasteful tiny warm champagne highlights. Wide 16:9 landscape. Very low contrast everywhere, intended behind dark readable Korean text and small UI controls. No distinct objects, no gems or crystals as subjects, no characters, no text, no borders or frame, no logos, no watermarks. Refined luminous material quality, restrained polished fantasy luxury. This is the texture itself, not a mockup or interface.
